body:
## Purpose and acceptance criteria (revision 2)

The owner has now explicitly requested committing everything on the current branch and merging it through a PR into main. This expands revision 1 from publishing the requested transcript to integrating that transcript plus the research collection created in this chat. The owner explicitly authorizes publishing these downloaded papers and the existing transcript; this overrides the normal exclusion of downloaded user content for these named files only.

1. Preserve books/The Pragmatic Programmer.txt byte-for-byte from published commit 31e7aa3c9efc7e2d7a2439f0155533316d4c27cb.
2. Commit the complete docs/research/ai-code-comments collection: four original PDFs, five separate-subagent HTML reviews (four full-text reviews and one clearly labeled abstract-only brief for the inaccessible paper), an offline HTML index, stylesheet, README source/checksum index, and unavailable-paper record. Do not represent the fifth PDF as downloaded or its full text as reviewed.
3. Verify all local HTML/Markdown links, PDF page targets and the four recorded PDF checksums; inspect offline Brave rendering at desktop and mobile widths. Summaries cover research design, models/timing, findings, limitations and practical lessons, distinguishing author findings from inference.
4. Run pwsh -NoProfile -File ./scripts/check.ps1 -Base 61b0cf5c9071c2ae9c43a47d898b81a6f14ce995 with documented dependencies. Obtain independent review of the exact published candidate/target tuple and revision 2 before merging.
5. Create and merge a PR into main with passing available CI, verify remote integration and the combined tree, preserve unrelated open acceptance work, clean up only this integrated task branch, obtain independent post-cleanup audit, then close this tracker.

## Assignment

- Branch: codex/14-book-transcript. Remote target: origin/main. Dispatch base: 61b0cf5c9071c2ae9c43a47d898b81a6f14ce995.
- Coordinator and sole Git-mutation owner: /root in the research-collection chat.
- Workspace: primary checkout A:/Claude/Book-connect; one worktree. Earlier writer finished at published transcript checkpoint 31e7aa3c9efc7e2d7a2439f0155533316d4c27cb.
- Owned paths: books/The Pragmatic Programmer.txt (preserve), docs/research/ai-code-comments/ (publish). No product code or other books.
- Reviews were authored by /root/review_self_comments, /root/review_bugfix_comments, /root/review_comment_traps, /root/review_documentation and /root/review_stale_comments. They have finished; /root owns shared index/CSS/README.
- Associated issues: #14 owns this artifact publication. #7 real-book owner accuracy acceptance and #2 release milestone remain open; this PR does not satisfy their remaining criteria.

## Progress

Completed November 6, 2026 via PR #15 at main a0f6852788fb1c755a4e44dc2e263f821baacffe. Published candidate e530286fff245ba3b14eeb05c9fc4e1d61df35ac passed independent review against the dispatch target and revision 2. All 90 local integration tests and both main CI jobs passed. Task branches removed after ancestry/tip verification; clean primary checkout on main. Independent post-cleanup audit by /root/candidate_review_14 passed. Issues #7 and #2 remain open. Detailed evidence is recorded in dated comments.

## Project context

The collection README records sources, availability, checksums and review entry points. Existing product intent, architecture and transcription guidance remain applicable: there is no product behavior change, no new commenting policy and no new claim of transcript accuracy.

comments.body: Published requested transcript on codex/14-book-transcript at 31e7aa3c9efc7e2d7a2439f0155533316d4c27cb; exact remote SHA verified. Dispatch base 61b0cf5c9071c2ae9c43a47d898b81a6f14ce995. Only books/The Pragmatic Programmer.txt committed; staged content verified against working file. All 90 tests and repository checks pass. Primary checkout clean on the task branch. Main remains unchanged; branch and tracker retained for any subsequent requested integration and its required review/cleanup. No application or documentation behavior changes.

## Published checkpoint — November 6, 2026

Criteria revision 2. Candidate e530286fff245ba3b14eeb05c9fc4e1d61df35ac is published on codex/14-book-transcript; exact remote SHA verified. Target main remains 61b0cf5c9071c2ae9c43a47d898b81a6f14ce995. PR: https://github.com/AndrewGodlewsky/Book-connect/pull/15.

The collection now has 14 committed files: the 13 requested artifacts plus a folder-local PDF binary attribute. Git's inherited astextplain PDF diff attribute initially caused binary whitespace false positives; the scoped binary rule fixes that and all four staged PDF byte hashes match the download inventory. The transcript Git blob d9123aaa1c536298817f804847eff649a4053c9f matches prior 31e7aa3 exactly (the Windows worktree uses CRLF while its committed blob uses LF).

Repository check passed 90 tests with zero skips using the installed BookConnect virtual environment. Six HTML pages passed offline Brave desktop/mobile rendering checks; local links and PDF page references resolve. No product code changed. The collection README owns the new documentation; existing architecture/product guidance remains applicable.

Independent fresh-context reviewer /root/candidate_review_14 is reviewing candidate e530286fff245ba3b14eeb05c9fc4e1d61df35ac against target 61b0cf5c9071c2ae9c43a47d898b81a6f14ce995 and revision 2. CI, candidate approval, PR integration, combined-tree verification, cleanup and final audit remain. #7 and #2 remain outside this artifact-publication scope.

## Independent candidate review — APPROVE

Reviewer: /root/candidate_review_14 (fresh context, not an implementer).
Criteria revision: 2.
Candidate: e530286fff245ba3b14eeb05c9fc4e1d61df35ac.
Target: 61b0cf5c9071c2ae9c43a47d898b81a6f14ce995.
Decision: APPROVE, no blocking findings.

Independent checks: required repository check passed 90 tests, zero skips; transcript committed blob unchanged from 31e7aa3; all four PDF hashes and page counts match the original local downloads and README; all 98 local links and 56 PDF page targets validated. Six HTML pages passed offline Brave checks at 1200px and 375px without overflow or browser errors. Principal factual findings were compared against all four local PDFs; the fifth brief consistently marks abstract-only evidence. Only assigned paths changed and checkout is clean. Original PDFs were not downloaded a second time. Browser automation was supplemented by the coordinator's earlier screenshot inspection.

All push and PR GitHub checks passed (runs 42166328256 and 42166333626). Integration, combined-tree checks, cleanup and final audit remain. Issues #7 and #2 remain open.

## Integration and scoped cleanup — November 6, 2026

PR #15 merged at a0f6852788fb1c755a4e44dc2e263f821baacffe. The remote main ref and local main checkout both match that SHA. Reviewed candidate e530286fff245ba3b14eeb05c9fc4e1d61df35ac is an ancestor of main, and git diff from candidate to merge tree is empty.

Combined-tree repository check passed 90 tests with zero skips. The primary checkout A:/Claude/Book-connect is clean on main. The task owner releases codex/14-book-transcript: both task refs were checked at the approved candidate tip, the local branch was deleted with git branch -d, and the remote branch was conditionally deleted using an exact-tip lease. Both refs are absent; only the primary main worktree remains. Existing ignored research cache and Python caches were preserved; no directories or unrelated work were removed.

Issue #14's artifact deliverables are integrated. #7 (real-book human acceptance) and #2 (release milestone) remain open because this PR does not complete them. Main CI run 42166619185 and the independent post-cleanup audit are the remaining closure checks. This tracker stays open pending that audit.

## Independent post-cleanup audit — PASS

Auditor: /root/candidate_review_14. Audited merged SHA: a0f6852788fb1c755a4e44dc2e263f821baacffe.

Independently verified PR #15 is merged and local/remote main match. Reviewed candidate e530286fff245ba3b14eeb05c9fc4e1d61df35ac is an ancestor and its tree equals the merged tree. Combined-tree checks passed all 90 tests; main CI run 42166619185 passed both jobs against the merged SHA. Local and remote task branches are absent; only the clean primary main checkout remains. Integrated content is reachable, ignored research/Python caches remain present, and there is no evidence of lost unique work. Issues #7 and #2 remain open for their separate acceptance criteria.

Decision: PASS, no blockers. Criteria revision 2 is complete. Closing this tracker after recording the audit; closed state will be read back.

title: Publish transcript and AI comment research collection through main PR
